author: CJ Lepus
title: Ads are unbearable
content:
Yes I understand you can pay to remove the ads but I have plenty of other games with ads that I don’t mind at all. These ads are so in your face that I genuinely can barely play the game. Every two minutes when I see the “ad break” pop up my blood pressure spikes. Some of the banner ads are programmed to automatically open browser tabs which is a huge no-no for me. And worst of all? The ads are so loud. I could be trying to play this to quietly pass the time in public with my phone on silent then boom — Sports betting ad at max volume with the tiniest mute button that’s impossible to press. 

The ads themselves also may not pause the music/podcasts I sometimes listen to while I play. But as soon as the ad concludes and I’m back in the game? My podcast pauses. Infuriating. 

Lastly the actual gameplay is so monotonous after a certain level. You unlock your last feature and then just nothing else. No unique level design. No new challenges. I’d be totally fine with this if the game were really able to be a time waster or a fidget type app. But with the constant ad interruptions it’s really not possible for it to fill that role without paying to remove them.

author: mwolford0130
title: Liars lol
content: Free version of this is unplayable. Constant interruptions (ad breaks between streaks AND ad breaks for powerups) and they sneak ads within tap ranges while you’re flowing (tons of accidental taps), regardless of how well you play. It’s a cheap “pay to win” dev strategy. Trust me…don’t play this. It’s very fun and very addictive but after a certain level you cannot beat it without ads; coin sorting logic literally corners you. Unless you pay don’t play ($6 is worth it maybe…but they’ve annoyed me so much I refuse to justify buying it. I’m bitter lol) . Fun while it lasted but I’m out

author: K Ax
title: A simple, solid game with a limited amount of ads.
content: The only ads associated with the game are for the daily bonuses. I enjoy playing the game for 15, 30, or even 45mins a day. The layout is simple enough. There are no level timers. The game can be stopped at anytime you wish and can be pick up right where you left off without having to watch ads. Watch out; every level has two colored coins that look very similar and can get you in a bind. Enjoy!

author: Twentyfun
title: Nonstop ads, very monotonous gameplay
content: This game has a good premise but never evolves into anything more than the same game play over and over. The ads are relentless, buggy and it feels like half of the game is watching mandatory ads. I’m more intrigued in the games being advertised than the game I am playing.

author: DvsCharmz
title: Forced ads even after paying for removal
content:
I paid for “forced ad removal” and instantaneously the levels became impossible to complete without watching as many adds as before. I watched 13 ads just to pass a level then tried to pass the next one without watching ads and it’s impossible. I’ve been on level 196 for 6 days and that’s collecting the free hourly gems. 
Tried the game on a different device without paying for “ad removal” and as long as you watch ads, the game is rather easy and I got to level 200 in 2 days.

author: BasilDragon
title: Waste of time
content: This could be fun if I could actually move up a level without having to watch a stupid ad to get everything to shuffle. I am sick of not being able to move up in any level - so often when I push ‘deal’, there are no options for sorting the coins that will actually work.  It forces you to lose the level. I enjoyed it at first, but this is not worth it anymore.

author: Daveowar
title: Toooo Many Ads
content: There is to many ads in this game to enjoy it! Almost impossible to get power ups without watching a ad video or for no reason after a couple rounds they force you to watch a video. The algorithm knows to drop new coins in to the slots to where you have to watch a video to open a bonus slot to make any moves but the time for the slot expires to quick before you’re stuck again!  If you could earn a power up every couple levels then it might be a little more fun or give you more options to complete each level without so many videos ads!
